_comment_auth_mode: Authentication policy mode: '2FA' (Identity Claim + Live Biometrics in ~2s) or '3FA' (Strict Exam Mode requiring RFC 6238 TOTP + Live Biometrics). Default: '2FA'.
_comment_grace_period: Number of consecutive missed checks before auto-locking. Higher = more lenient for moving around.
_comment_tolerance: Biometric strictness. Lower = stricter matching (fewer false positives, more false negatives). Default 0.6.
_comment_max_pause: Maximum seconds the user can pause monitoring before the fail-safe auto-resumes.
_comment_alerting: Webhook URL for Real-Time Incident Alerting (e.g., Discord). Leave empty to disable.
